ANCIENT_EGYPT-1.description: Sand shifts across the ancient tombs and the dead do not rest. Ra Zombies guard the pyramids and will bury anything that stands between them and your brain. Build a steady sun economy first, then wall off the lanes before the second wave crests.

ANCIENT_EGYPT-3.description: Night operations in the deep tombs. Visibility is poor and the horde travels in packs, so lean on plants that cover several lanes at once rather than single-target damage.

DARK_AGES-1.description: Darkness falls over the ruins and a boss zombie stalks the lawn. Every wave brings reinforcements out of the gloom. Choose a lineup that balances sun production, sustained damage and emergency defense, because you will not get a second chance once the horde commits.

BIG_WAVE_BEACH-1.description: The tide rolls in and redraws the shoreline. Keep lily pads ready for the water, and watch for low-tide ambushes on the newly dry sand.

FROSTBITE_CAVES-1.description: Bitter wind howls through the ice caverns. Plants freeze solid if left unattended, so pack a way to thaw your defenses and keep the pressure on between gusts.
